notes:
Source: 2022 (72nd) Final Report, Anonymity-Protected Digital Edition, 168 PDF pages (PDF page = printed page + 1). Rosters on PDF pp.159-167 (printed 158-166). Conference: April 24-30, 2022, New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge, Brooklyn, NY. It was the first in-person Conference since 2019, and Covid affected it heavily.
VALIDATOR WARNINGS (2), explained: "POLICY: 0 chairs marked" and "POLICY: 0 alt chairs marked". The 2022 Conference Committees roster prints no * or ** mark on any Policy and Admissions member (I checked the page image of PDF p.159). Nothing else in the report names the 2022 Policy/Admissions chair or alternate chair, so every member is recorded as role "member".
DELEGATES: There are 93 areas: 48 Panel 71 delegates (second year, rotating) and 45 Panel 72 delegates (first year). Names use the Area Delegates list spelling, including printed nicknames such as "Cheryl (Sherry) S.", "Montrell (Monty) C." and "William (Bill) F.". The same spelling is used in conference_committees and next_year_chairs, where the rosters print short forms (e.g. "Sherry S.", "Bill F."; the 2023 chairs table prints "Cheryl S."). The opening narrative says two sitting delegates withdrew because of Covid and their alternates stepped in. Advisory Actions 16-17 (Policy/Admissions) seated Rio D., alternate for Area 79 BC/Yukon (in place of Bob K., Panel 71), and Christopher M., alternate for Area 47 Central New York (in place of Todd D., Panel 71). Those two areas have status "alternate". "name" keeps the printed Panel 71 delegate, and an extra key "alternate_seated" names the alternate. The committee rosters still list Bob K. (Policy and Admissions) and Todd D. (Trustees). Printed oddities fixed: (1) the Agenda roster prints "Sally T. - Area 35, Area 12, Delaware", which I recorded as Area 12 to match the delegate list; (2) the city "Salt Lake CIty" was normalized; (3) the stray page number after "Spring Lake, NJ" was removed. The Area 42 (Nevada) delegate's city is printed as Chester, CA, and the Area 92 delegate's as Hauser, ID; both are kept as printed.
CONFERENCE COMMITTEES: There are 11 primary committees with 93 members (every area on exactly one), plus 2 secondary committees, Archives and International Conventions/Regional Forums, marked with superscript 1. Staff secretaries are as printed. "Diana L. (interim)" (CPC) and "Sandra W. (interim)" (Corrections) are recorded with secretary_note "interim". The Finance secretary is printed with a nickname and full surname; she is a nonalcoholic employee (Assistant Director of Finance) and is reduced to "Zenny M." (the trustees' Finance roster prints her given name, reduced to "Zenaida M."). The Archives secretary (Archives Director, nonalcoholic, printed with full surname) is reduced to "Michelle M.". The committee printed as "Grapevine" is canonical GRAPEVINE (called "Grapevine and La Viña" in the Advisory Actions).
NEXT-YEAR CHAIRS: These come from the "2023 Conference Chairpersons and Alternate Chairpersons" table, where areas are printed by name only and were mapped to area numbers. Archives and ICRF are marked secondary (*) in that table. All chairs and alternates are Panel 72 members of the same committee in 2022. Richard M. (Area 80, Manitoba) is printed as the alternate for both Public Information and ICRF (his primary and secondary committees). Corrections prints "Kurt W. Maryland" (missing comma), and Treatment prints "Cheryl S." for the delegate the rosters call Sherry S.
TRUSTEES' COMMITTEES: In this table "*" means Appointed Committee Member (ACM): Amalia C. and Katie H. on Literature, Morgan B. and Kirk H. on Public Information. These four are recorded as type "appointed". No trustees' committee is secondary. The "*secondary" footnote that the text extraction places there belongs to the 2023 chairs table above it. The footnote says the GSB chair (Linda C.) is ex officio on all committees, and the GSO general manager is ex officio on all except Audit, Compensation and Nominating. Neither is listed as a member. ICRF has two secretaries, Sandra W. (interim, International Conventions) and James H. (Regional Forums): "secretary" holds Sandra W. and the extra key "secretaries" holds both. The CPC/Treatment and Accessibilities secretary Diana L. is printed as "interim secretary". The Audit secretary (CFO), the Compensation secretary and the Finance secretary are nonalcoholic employees printed with full surnames, reduced to "Paul K.", "Sareen P." and "Zenaida M.".
NAMES: Class A trustees and nonalcoholic employees are printed with full surnames and were reduced to first name + last initial. Middle initials, honorifics ("Sr."/"Sister", "Hon.", "Judge") and professional suffixes (JD, CSA, FACHE, III, MD, FAAFP, FASAM, MBA, CFA, CPA) were dropped. Results: Molly A. (bio prints a middle initial before the surname), Linda C., Nancy M., Al M., Kevin P., Christine C., Kerry M. and Anadora (Andie) M. (bio: Anadora "Andie"). Judith Ann K. is used in trustees[] (bio prints Judith Ann). Judith K. is used in the trustees' committee roster (which prints Sister Judith). Trustee and director bios print given names with nicknames: "James (Jimmy) D.", "Kathryn (Kathi) F." (bio: Kathryn F., "Kathi"), "Patricia (Trish) L.", "Inocencio (Ino) F.". trustees[] and nontrustee_directors[] use those forms. Trustees' committees, officers and board lists use the printed short forms (Jimmy D., Kathi F., Trish L., Ino F.). Full surnames are not reproduced anywhere in this file.
TRUSTEES: There are 21 (7 Class A, 14 Class B). Five are marked "*Rotating at the close of the 2022 Conference": Christine C., Nancy M., Beau B., Kathi F. and Jan L. The nontrustee directors Ino F. and Carolyn W. are also marked rotating. trustee_committees come from the 2022 Trustees' Committees roster, with "(chair)" where marked. Linda C. appears in no roster (ex officio), so her list comes from her bio. Some bios differ slightly from the roster. Francis G.'s bio says he serves on Compensation, while the roster shows him as its chair (roster used). Kathi F. chairs the trustees' Conference Committee. Bios also name non-standing committees that were not included: Judith Ann K. on Orientation 2022 and 1728; Tom H. as vice chair of CPC/TA and ICRF; Cathi C. on Audit. elected_year: Francis G.'s bio gives no year, so it is null. Linda C. is 2021, the year she was elected GSB chair after the 71st Conference (she was earlier a Class A trustee 1996-2002). Nancy M. is 2016 (approved by the Conference that year). past_delegate.area is null where the bio gives a panel but no area: Jimmy D. (P59), Francis G. (P57), Tom H. (P62), Trish L. (P57), Marita R. (P49), Irma V. (P59), Ino F. (P60), Cindy F. (P61), and the newly elected Joyce S. (P65). Cathi C.'s area 23 is inferred from her bio ("Panel 64 delegate ... most recently as Area 23 archivist"). Mike L.'s bio prints "Panel 53 delegate from Area 24" (Iowa), although he lives in Omaha, NE; recorded as printed. board_roles come from the GSB officers list and the AAWS/AA Grapevine director lists.
NEWLY ELECTED: The Board elected five trustees after the 2022 Conference ("five new trustees were selected on Wednesday afternoon"): Class A Kerry M. and Anadora (Andie) M.; Class B Reilly K. (Pacific) and Joyce S. (Eastern Canada); and Carolyn W. as general service trustee. It also elected two nontrustee directors, Clinton M. (AAWS) and David S. (AA Grapevine). Their heading misprints "following the 2021 Conference", but both bios say they were elected in April 2022. "class" is null for the two directors.
STAFF: gso_staff is the 10 names in the "General Service Office Staff" list. Assignments come from the signed staff reports in "Trustees' Committees and Staff Reports" and from the committee secretaryships printed in the 2022 Conference Committees and Trustees' Committees rosters: Steve S. (Conference; secretary of Agenda), Diana L. (Nominating; secretary of the Conference Committee on Trustees; interim secretary of CPC), Craig W. (Group Services; secretary of Report and Charter), Jeff W. (staff coordinator; secretary of Policy and Admissions and of the G.S.B. Sharing Session). Sandra W. is Director of Staff Services (G.S.O. department reports) and was also interim coordinator for Corrections and International Conventions. Jeff W. is the staff coordinator (secretary to Conference Policy/Admissions and assistant secretary of the GSB). Two staff appear in the report but not in the staff list: Amy B., who signed the CPC staff report, and Eileen A., printed as secretary of the trustees' Corrections Committee. Both are left out of gso_staff. grapevine_staff is as printed: Karina C. (associate editor, La Viña) and Jon W. (senior editor). Chris C. (AAGV publisher) appears only in the AA Grapevine directors list. general_manager "Bob W." follows the narrative and board reports; the AAWS directors list prints "Robert W., G.S.O. general manager", which is kept as printed there. staff_director is "Sandra W.". conference_chair is Pam K., Western Missouri (Area 39), who signed the Greetings as "Delegate Chair". farewell_count is null because no number is stated: the narrative only mentions "a heartfelt round of goodbyes from rotating Panel 71 delegates", and there are 48 Panel 71 delegates. The report has no separate "Delegate Farewells" section.
